questions.text: A is the mother of B. C is the sister of A. D is the son of C. How is D related to B?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Cousin.

questions.text: In the context of the Vedic Age, the transition from Early Vedic to Later Vedic period is marked by which significant political development?

options.label: A
options.text: The replacement of the tribal assembly (samiti) by a hereditary monarchy with no checks on royal power

options.label: B
options.text: The emergence of territorial states (janapadas) from the earlier tribal (jana) organization

options.label: C
options.text: The establishment of a centralized imperial bureaucracy modeled on the Indus Valley administration

options.label: D
options.text: The introduction of the varna system as a rigid, birth-based hierarchy replacing occupational divisions

questions.solution: Correct answer: The emergence of territorial states (janapadas) from the earlier tribal (jana) organization.

questions.text: Which credit instrument allowed merchants to transfer funds across the Indo‑Gangetic plain without moving bullion in early medieval India?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Hundi.

questions.text: The Indus Valley Civilization is known for its sophisticated system of
questions.solution: The Indus Valley Civilization is known for its sophisticated system of irrigation, which included advanced water management systems and reservoirs.

questions.text: The ancient Indian university of Nalanda was founded in the
questions.solution: The ancient Indian university of Nalanda was founded in the 5th century AD, during the Gupta period.

questions.text: Passage: 'Democracy is not merely a form of government; it is a way of life that requires active participation from citizens. Without an informed and engaged citizenry, democratic institutions become hollow and susceptible to manipulation.' The author's primary argument is that:

options.label: B
options.text: Citizen participation is essential for democracy to function properly

options.label: C
options.text: Democratic institutions are naturally resistant to manipulation

options.label: D
options.text: Informed citizens are less likely to participate in democracy

questions.solution: Correct answer: Citizen participation is essential for democracy to function properly.

questions.text: The theoretical foundation of Indian classical dance forms is codified in which ancient treatise?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Natya Shastra.

questions.text: In which year was Tamil officially recognised as a classical language by the Government of India?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 2004.

questions.text: The ancient Indian city of Mohenjo-Daro is located in
questions.solution: The ancient Indian city of Mohenjo-Daro is located in Pakistan.

questions.text: Which statement about the water management systems of medieval capitals is supported by the text?

options.label: A
options.text: Fatehpur Sikri's water supply relied solely on the Yamuna river

options.label: B
options.text: Vijayanagara's hydraulic system included the Tungabhadra dam and a network of canals

options.label: C
options.text: Tughluq Delhi's water infrastructure was entirely planned before settlement

options.label: D
options.text: The abandonment of Fatehpur Sikri was due to political instability rather than water scarcity

questions.solution: Correct answer: Vijayanagara's hydraulic system included the Tungabhadra dam and a network of canals.

questions.text: A man walks 5 km East, turns right and walks 3 km, turns right and walks 5 km, turns left and walks 4 km. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 7 km.

questions.text: A can do a work in 15 days and B in 10 days. In how many days can they complete the work together?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 6 days.

questions.text: Passage: 'The Right to Information Act 2005 has been a landmark legislation in empowering citizens. By providing access to government records, it has enhanced transparency and accountability in public administration.' The main idea of the passage is:

options.label: B
options.text: RTI Act has empowered citizens and improved transparency

options.label: C
options.text: Government records should be kept confidential

options.label: D
options.text: RTI Act has reduced corruption completely

questions.solution: Correct answer: RTI Act has empowered citizens and improved transparency.

questions.text: The largest living species of lizard is the
questions.solution: The Komodo dragon is the largest living species of lizard, found primarily in the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, and Flores.

questions.text: The process of water moving through a plant, from the roots to the leaves, and being released into the air as water vapor is called
questions.solution: The process of water moving through a plant, from the roots to the leaves, and being released into the air as water vapor is called transpiration.

questions.text: The ancient Indian epic, the Mahabharata, is attributed to the sage
questions.solution: The ancient Indian epic, the Mahabharata, is attributed to the sage Vyasa.

questions.text: The average of 5 numbers is 20. If one number is removed, the average becomes 18. What number was removed?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 28.

questions.text: Some doctors are teachers. No teacher is a lawyer. All lawyers are judges. Which of these conclusions definitely follow? I. Some doctors are not lawyers. II. No teacher is a judge.
questions.solution: Correct answer: Both I and II.

questions.text: You are a government officer. You discover that a welfare scheme meant for the poor is being misused by a local politician who is also your relative. What should you do?

options.label: A
options.text: Ignore it since he is a relative

options.label: B
options.text: Report the matter through proper channels

questions.solution: Correct answer: Report the matter through proper channels.

questions.text: Your subordinate has been consistently late to work but is otherwise excellent at his job. What is the best course of action?

options.label: A
options.text: Ignore it since his work is good

options.label: B
options.text: Give him a written warning immediately

options.label: C
options.text: Speak with him privately to understand the reason and find a solution

questions.solution: Correct answer: Speak with him privately to understand the reason and find a solution.

questions.text: Which of the following correctly matches a Bhakti tradition with its organisational form?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Nirguna tradition – sangats.

questions.text: The Sun Temple at Konark was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in which year?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 1984.

questions.text: The concept of 'Panchayati Raj' was introduced in India by
questions.solution: The concept of 'Panchayati Raj' was introduced in India by Jawaharlal Nehru in 1959, with the aim of decentralizing power and promoting grassroots democracy.

questions.text: The Indian Constitution guarantees the right to freedom of speech and expression under
questions.solution: The Indian Constitution guarantees the right to freedom of speech and expression under Article 19.

questions.text: You are an IAS officer. A senior minister asks you to approve a file that you believe violates departmental rules. What should you do?

options.label: A
options.text: Approve it since the minister is senior

options.label: B
options.text: Respectfully explain your concerns and refuse to approve

options.label: C
options.text: Approve but record your objections in the file

options.label: D
options.text: Go on leave to avoid the situation

questions.solution: Correct answer: Respectfully explain your concerns and refuse to approve.

questions.text: The term 'tsunami' is derived from the Japanese words 'tsu' meaning
questions.solution: The term 'tsunami' is derived from the Japanese words 'tsu' meaning 'harbour' and 'nami' meaning 'wave'.

questions.text: Which of the following rivers flows through the Satpura range?
questions.solution: The Narmada river flows through the Satpura range, which is located in central India.

questions.text: If 15% of a number is 45, what is the number?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 300.

questions.text: During a disaster, you have limited supplies. Who should receive priority?
questions.solution: Correct answer: The most critically injured.

questions.text: Who is the author of the book 'India After Gandhi'?
questions.solution: The book 'India After Gandhi' is written by Ramachandra Guha, an Indian historian and writer.

questions.text: The Indian Constitution provides for a Council of Ministers headed by the
questions.solution: The Indian Constitution provides for a Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister, as stated in Article 75.

questions.text: Which of the following features of the Indus Valley Civilization most strongly indicates the existence of a centralized authority or widely shared technical tradition across geographically dispersed sites?

options.label: A
options.text: The grid-based street layout intersecting at right angles in major cities

options.label: B
options.text: The use of standardized baked bricks measuring 7 × 14 × 28 centimetres across sites hundreds of kilometres apart

options.label: C
options.text: The presence of the Great Bath at Mohenjo-Daro lined with bitumen

options.label: D
options.text: The sophisticated covered drainage system with manholes and soak pits

questions.solution: Correct answer: The use of standardized baked bricks measuring 7 × 14 × 28 centimetres across sites hundreds of kilometres apart.

questions.text: Passage: 'The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has raised concerns about job displacement. However, history suggests that technological revolutions create new categories of employment even as they render some jobs obsolete.' What can be inferred from the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: AI will definitely cause mass unemployment

options.label: B
options.text: Technological change has historically led to new job creation alongside job loss

options.label: C
options.text: AI is different from previous technological revolutions

options.label: D
options.text: Job displacement due to AI is a new phenomenon

questions.solution: Correct answer: Technological change has historically led to new job creation alongside job loss.

questions.text: In Akbar’s zabt revenue system, the term "polaj" designated which category of land?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Annually cultivated land.

questions.text: The concept of 'dyarchy' was introduced in India by the:
questions.solution: The concept of 'dyarchy' was introduced in India by the Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms of 1919, which divided the subjects into 'transferred' and 'reserved' categories.

questions.text: In a pie chart, the central angle for a category is 90°. If total is 2400, what is the category value?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 600.

questions.text: Which of the following dance forms is NOT among the eight classical dance styles recognised by the Sangeet Natak Akademi?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Bhangra.

questions.text: Which of the following rivers is known as the 'Ganga of the South'?
questions.solution: The Godavari River is often referred to as the 'Ganga of the South' due to its cultural and geographical significance in southern India.

questions.text: The concept of 'carbon credit' is related to
questions.solution: The concept of 'carbon credit' is related to greenhouse gas emissions reduction, as it allows countries or companies to buy or sell credits representing the right to emit a certain amount of greenhouse gases.

questions.text: Find the missing term: 7, 14, 28, 56, ?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 112.

questions.text: The concept of 'secularism' in the Indian Constitution means
questions.solution: The concept of 'secularism' in the Indian Constitution means separation of church and state, where the state does not promote or favor any particular religion.

questions.text: The 'Navigation Acts' were passed by the:
questions.solution: The Navigation Acts were a series of laws passed by the British Parliament to restrict the use of foreign shipping and promote British trade.

questions.text: A policy decision will benefit 80% of the population but harm 20%. What approach should guide your decision?

options.label: A
options.text: Reject the policy since it harms some people

options.label: B
options.text: Implement the policy without considering the affected 20%

options.label: C
options.text: Implement the policy with adequate compensation and support for the affected 20%

questions.solution: Correct answer: Implement the policy with adequate compensation and support for the affected 20%.

questions.text: The term 'tsunami' is associated with:
questions.solution: Tsunamis are large ocean waves caused by underwater earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, or landslides.

questions.text: Passage: 'Despite decades of economic reforms, rural poverty remains stubbornly high. The benefits of growth have disproportionately accrued to urban areas, leaving rural communities struggling with inadequate infrastructure and limited access to markets.' The tone of the passage is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: Critical.

questions.text: Which of the following rivers is known for its reverse flow during the monsoon season?
questions.solution: The Brahmaputra river is known for its reverse flow during the monsoon season due to the heavy rainfall and resulting water flow.

questions.text: The largest planet in our solar system is
questions.solution: The largest planet in our solar system is Jupiter.

questions.text: Which post‑Mauryan dynasty in the north‑west is known for issuing bilingual (Greek and Prakrit) inscriptions and Hellenistic coinage at cities such as Taxila and Sagala?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Indo‑Greek kingdoms.

questions.text: A train 200 m long crosses a platform 400 m long in 30 seconds. Find the speed of the train.
questions.solution: Correct answer: 72 km/h.

questions.text: What was the fixed exchange ratio between the copper jital and the silver tanka established by the Mamluk sultans?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 48 jitals = 1 tanka.

questions.text: As of 2024, how many cultural UNESCO World Heritage Sites does India possess?
questions.solution: Correct answer: 34.

questions.text: The concept of 'dyarchy' was introduced in India by the:
questions.solution: The concept of 'dyarchy' was introduced in India by the Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms of 1919, which divided the subjects into 'transferred' and 'reserved' categories.

questions.text: According to the Natyashastra, the rasa experience is generated through the combination of sthayi bhava with which three components?
questions.solution: Correct answer: Vibhava, anubhava, and vyabhichari bhava.

questions.text: The process by which plants convert sunlight into energy is called
questions.solution: The process by which plants convert sunlight into energy is called photosynthesis.

questions.text: If GROUND is coded as HSPVOE, how is CLEAN coded?
questions.solution: Correct answer: DMFBO.

questions.text: Passage: 'Climate change is often presented as an environmental issue, but it is fundamentally a development challenge. Poor communities in developing countries bear the brunt of climate impacts despite contributing the least to greenhouse gas emissions.' What is the author's main point?

options.label: A
options.text: Climate change is only an environmental problem

options.label: B
options.text: Developing countries should not be concerned about climate change

options.label: C
options.text: Climate change is a development challenge with disproportionate impact on the poor

options.label: D
options.text: Rich countries suffer most from climate change

questions.solution: Correct answer: Climate change is a development challenge with disproportionate impact on the poor.

questions.text: The term 'Homo sapiens' refers to which species?
questions.solution: The term 'Homo sapiens' refers to modern humans, who are the only living species of the genus Homo.

questions.text: The 'Chipko movement' was primarily concerned with:
questions.solution: The Chipko movement was a non-violent resistance movement in India that aimed to conserve forests and prevent deforestation.

questions.text: Consider the following statements regarding the National Green Tribunal (NGT): 1. It is a specialized body set up to expeditiously deal with environmental related litigation. 2. The head of the NGT is known as the Chairperson, who is appointed by the President of India. 3. The decisions of the NGT are not subject to appeal in any court of law. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution: Statement 1 is correct as the NGT was established under the National Green Tribunal Act, 2010 to handle environmental disputes quickly. Statement 2 is correct; the Chairperson of the NGT is appointed by the President of India. Statement 3 is incorrect because Section 14 of the NGT Act allows for appeals to be filed directly to the Supreme Court of India against any order or decision of the Tribunal.

questions.text: What is the name of the Indian government's scheme to provide financial assistance to farmers for the purchase of seeds and fertilizers?
questions.solution: The Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana is a scheme to provide financial assistance to farmers for the purchase of seeds and fertilizers.

questions.text: Which of the following countries is the world's largest emitter of greenhouse gases?
questions.solution: According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), China is the world's largest emitter of greenhouse gases.

questions.text: Which of the following countries has the largest number of billionaires in the world?
questions.solution: According to the Forbes Billionaires List, the United States has the largest number of billionaires in the world.

questions.text: The 'Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana' was launched in:
questions.solution: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana was launched on August 15, 2014, to promote financial inclusion and provide banking services to all households.

questions.text: The 'Make in India' initiative was launched by the Government of India in:
questions.solution: The 'Make in India' initiative was launched by the Government of India on September 25, 2014, to promote manufacturing and investment in the country.

questions.text: What is the name of the Indian space mission that successfully landed a rover on the Moon's south pole?
questions.solution: Chandrayaan-3 is the Indian space mission that successfully landed a rover on the Moon's south pole.

questions.text: The 'Ease of Doing Business' index is published by
questions.solution: The 'Ease of Doing Business' index is published by the World Bank, which ranks countries based on their business environment and regulatory framework.

questions.text: The 'Paris Agreement' is an international agreement aimed at mitigating
questions.solution: The 'Paris Agreement' is an international agreement aimed at mitigating climate change by reducing greenhouse gas emissions and limiting global warming to well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels.

questions.text: The 'Ayushman Bharat' scheme was launched by the Government of India in:
questions.solution: The Ayushman Bharat scheme, also known as the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana, was launched by the Government of India on September 23, 2018, to provide health insurance to economically vulnerable families.

questions.text: The 'Global Hunger Index' is published by:
questions.solution: The Global Hunger Index is published by the International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI) in partnership with Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe.

questions.text: Which of the following countries is the largest producer of milk in the world?
questions.solution: According to the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the United Nations, India is the largest producer of milk in the world.

questions.text: Which of the following international organizations is responsible for promoting global health and well-being?
questions.solution: The World Health Organization (WHO) is responsible for promoting global health and well-being.

questions.text: The 'Swachh Bharat Abhiyan' is a national campaign launched by the Government of India to
questions.solution: The 'Swachh Bharat Abhiyan' is a national campaign launched by the Government of India to improve sanitation and cleanliness, with the goal of achieving a clean and hygienic India.
